operations.description:
Deletes an existing subscription. All pending messages in the subscription
are immediately dropped. Calls to `Pull` after deletion will return
`NOT_FOUND`. After a subscription is deleted, a new one may be created with
the same name, but the new one has no association with the old
subscription, or its topic unless the same topic is specified.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] pubsub projects subscriptions delete [PATH] v 1beta 2 [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota subscription token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Deletes the topic with the given name. Returns `NOT_FOUND` if the topic
does not exist. After a topic is deleted, a new topic may be created with
the same name; this is an entirely new topic with none of the old
configuration or subscriptions. Existing subscriptions to this topic are
not deleted, but their `topic` field is set to `_deleted-topic_`.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] pubsub projects topics delete [PATH] v 1beta 2 [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota token topic type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA]

Sets the access control policy on the specified resource. Replaces any
existing policy.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] pubsub projects topics set iam policy [PATH] v 1beta 2 resource set iam policy [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota resource token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] binding expr iam policy request set

operations.description:
Returns permissions that a caller has on the specified resource.
If the resource does not exist, this will return an empty set of
permissions, not a NOT_FOUND error.

Note: This operation is designed to be used for building permission-aware
UIs and command-line tools, not for authorization checking. This operation
may "fail open" without warning.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] pubsub projects topics test iam permissions [PATH] v 1beta 2 resource test iam permissions [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota resource token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] iam permissions request response test

operations.description:
Acknowledges the messages associated with the `ack_ids` in the
`AcknowledgeRequest`. The Pub/Sub system can remove the relevant messages
from the subscription.

Acknowledging a message whose ack deadline has expired may succeed,
but such a message may be redelivered later. Acknowledging a message more
than once will not result in an error.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] pubsub projects subscriptions acknowledge [PATH] v 1beta 2 subscription acknowledge [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota subscription token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] acknowledge request

operations.description:
Modifies the ack deadline for a specific message. This method is useful
to indicate that more time is needed to process a message by the
subscriber, or to make the message available for redelivery if the
processing was interrupted. Note that this does not modify the
subscription-level `ackDeadlineSeconds` used for subsequent messages.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] pubsub projects subscriptions modify ack deadline [PATH] v 1beta 2 subscription modify ack deadline [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota subscription token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] ack deadline modify request

operations.description:
Modifies the `PushConfig` for a specified subscription.

This may be used to change a push subscription to a pull one (signified by
an empty `PushConfig`) or vice versa, or change the endpoint URL and other
attributes of a push subscription. Messages will accumulate for delivery
continuously through the call regardless of changes to the `PushConfig`.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] pubsub projects subscriptions modify push config [PATH] v 1beta 2 subscription modify push config [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota subscription token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] config modify oidc push request token

operations.description:
Pulls messages from the server. Returns an empty list if there are no
messages available in the backlog. The server may return `UNAVAILABLE` if
there are too many concurrent pull requests pending for the given
subscription.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] pubsub projects subscriptions pull [PATH] v 1beta 2 subscription pull [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota subscription token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] message pubsub pull received request response

operations.description:
Adds one or more messages to the topic. Returns `NOT_FOUND` if the topic
does not exist. The message payload must not be empty; it must contain
 either a non-empty data field, or at least one attribute.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] pubsub projects topics publish [PATH] v 1beta 2 topic publish [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota token topic type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] message publish pubsub request response

operations.description: Creates the given topic with the given name.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] pubsub projects topics create [PATH] v 1beta 2 [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] topic
